# Hypothesis: click only green blocks aligned with purple targets (cols 15, 21, 27)
# Purple targets are at cols 15, 21, 27
# Green blocks are at cols 15, 21, 27, 33, 39, 45, 51 (2 rows)

seg = current_frame.segmentation
green = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']

# Find green blocks at cols 15, 21, 27
target_cols = {15, 21, 27}
aligned_green = []
for g in green:
    cc = sum(pt[1] for pt in g['boundary']) // len(g['boundary'])
    if cc in target_cols:
        cr = sum(pt[0] for pt in g['boundary']) // len(g['boundary'])
        aligned_green.append((cr, cc, g['id']))
        print(f"Aligned green at ({cr}, {cc})")

print(f"\nTotal aligned green blocks: {len(aligned_green)}")

# Click them one by one
for cr, cc, gid in aligned_green:
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])
    if result.get('game_over'):
        print(f"GAME OVER clicking ({cr}, {cc})")
        break
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    green_count = len([n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N'])
    print(f"After click ({cr},{cc}): {green_count} green blocks remain")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
